osuna-c3456-d107.summary: The Pope has refused Don Antonio Ronquillo passage for 500 horse sent by the viceroy to help the Grand Duke of Tuscany, but would grant it towards Milan; Ridolfi advises accepting, since from Forlì the cavalry can turn into Tuscany if the French attack. News of the French fleet near La Spezia; a landing towards the Val di Taro and the Parmesan is more likely; Souvré's talks with 'that Duke'; Vendôme and the Huguenots' plan to rise; the Almirante would pay Vendôme 12,000 ducats; the Bouillon negotiation is stuck and Ridolfi fears Bouillon will come to terms with the French, Mazarin always doubling his offers.
osuna-c3456-d107.en:
This morning the Pope refused Signor Don Antonio Ronquillo passage for the five hundred horse that [Your Excellency, 126]
wishes to send to the relief of the [Grand Duke, 107], but he said that he would grant it for the State of Milan. I have
proposed to Signor Don Antonio that he accept the passage in the form in which [His Holiness, 101] is willing to grant it,
because when this cavalry is in the city of Forlì in the Romagna, from where the road runs straight towards Bologna, if the
[Grand Duke] has been attacked by the [French, 121] and needs this relief, they will be able to enter the State of the
[Grand Duke], the border being no more than twelve miles away; but if the [Grand Duke] has no need of them, they will go on
along the road towards Bologna and towards the State of Milan.

system: Numbered Italian cipher: 20-24 = a e i o u and 25-44 = the alphabet a ... u (so two codes per vowel); syllables in series of five (b 49-53, m 54-58, l 59-63, n 65-69, d 70-74, t 75-79, g 80-84, f 85-90, z 91-95), 64/97 = che, 98 = chi; nomenclator 100-243; a…
